detail.longDescription: Mozilla revoked an exposed GPG signing subkey and issued a replacement after the private key was accidentally committed to a GitHub repository. 🔐 Mozilla found no evidence of unauthorized access, while users who manually verify signatures must import the new key and revoke the old one. 🦊 @ mozilla 🔗 https://www. securityweek.com/mozilla-issue s-new-firefox-gpg-key-following-exposure/ # TechNews # Firefox # Mozilla # GPG # SupplyChain # Cybersecurity # OpenSource # Security # Privacy # FOSS # Linux # Software # Technology
